// ── RENDER ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{
  const W = width
  const H = 540

  // instruction bar
  const infoBar = html`<div style="font-size:12px;color:#666;margin-bottom:8px;
    padding:7px 12px;background:#f5f5f5;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #e0e0e0">
    <strong>How to use:</strong> Hover a node to preview · <strong>Click a node</strong> to pin papers in the panel below · Click background to reset · Drag nodes to rearrange
  </div>`
  yield infoBar

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("width", W)
    .attr("height", H)
    .style("font-family", "sans-serif")
    .style("background", "#fafaf8")
    .style("border-radius", "8px")
    .style("border", "1px solid #ddd")
    .style("display", "block")

  // paper panel below svg
  const panel = html`<div id="paper-panel" style="
    margin-top:12px;
    border:1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:16px 20px;
    background:#fff;
    min-height:80px;
    font-family:sans-serif;
    font-size:13px;
    display:none">
  </div>`

  const nodes = [
    ...species_nodes.map(d => ({...d})),
    ...theme_nodes.map(d => ({...d}))
  ]

  const links = edges.map(e => ({
    ...e,
    source: nodes.find(n => n.id === e.source),
    target: nodes.find(n => n.id === e.target)
  }))

  const maxWeight = d3.max(links, d => d.weight)

  const sim = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
    .force("link", d3.forceLink(links)
      .id(d => d.id)
      .distance(d => d.target.type === "shared" ? 170 : 140)
      .strength(0.7)
    )
    .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-450))
    .force("center", d3.forceCenter(W / 2, H / 2))
    .force("collision", d3.forceCollide().radius(d => d.type === "species" ? 52 : 42))

  // edges
  const link = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("line")
    .data(links)
    .join("line")
    .attr("stroke", d => d.target.colour)
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.4)
    .attr("stroke-width", d => 1.5 + (d.weight / maxWeight) * 7)
    .attr("stroke-linecap", "round")

  // node groups
  const node = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("g")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("g")
    .style("cursor", "pointer")
    .call(d3.drag()
      .on("start", (event, d) => {
        if (!event.active) sim.alphaTarget(0.3).restart()
        d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y
      })
      .on("drag", (event, d) => { d.fx = event.x; d.fy = event.y })
      .on("end", (event, d) => {
        if (!event.active) sim.alphaTarget(0)
        d.fx = null; d.fy = null
      })
    )

  // shadow filter
  const defs = svg.append("defs")
  const filter = defs.append("filter").attr("id","shadow").attr("x","-20%").attr("y","-20%").attr("width","140%").attr("height","140%")
  filter.append("feDropShadow").attr("dx",0).attr("dy",2).attr("stdDeviation",3).attr("flood-opacity",0.15)

  // circles
  node.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d => d.type === "species" ? 42 : 32)
    .attr("fill", d => d.colour)
    .attr("fill-opacity", d => d.type === "species" ? 1 : 0.85)
    .attr("stroke", "#fff")
    .attr("stroke-width", 3)
    .attr("filter","url(#shadow)")

  // labels
  node.append("text")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", d => d.type === "species" ? "13px" : "10.5px")
    .attr("font-weight", d => d.type === "species" ? "700" : "600")
    .attr("fill", "#fff")
    .attr("pointer-events", "none")
    .each(function(d) {
      const words = d.label.split(" ")
      const el = d3.select(this)
      if (words.length <= 2 || d.type === "species") {
        el.attr("dy","0.35em").text(d.label)
      } else {
        const mid = Math.ceil(words.length / 2)
        el.append("tspan").attr("x",0).attr("dy","-0.6em").text(words.slice(0,mid).join(" "))
        el.append("tspan").attr("x",0).attr("dy","1.25em").text(words.slice(mid).join(" "))
      }
    })

  // paper count
  node.filter(d => d.type !== "species")
    .append("text")
    .attr("text-anchor","middle")
    .attr("dy","2.8em")
    .attr("font-size","9px")
    .attr("fill","rgba(255,255,255,0.75)")
    .attr("pointer-events","none")
    .text(d => {
      const count = links
        .filter(l => l.target.id === d.id || l.source.id === d.id)
        .reduce((s,l) => s + l.weight, 0)
      return `${count} paper${count!==1?"s":""}`
    })

  // hover highlight
  node.on("mouseenter", function(event, d) {
    const connected = new Set([d.id])
    links.forEach(l => {
      if (l.source.id === d.id) connected.add(l.target.id)
      if (l.target.id === d.id) connected.add(l.source.id)
    })
    node.selectAll("circle").attr("fill-opacity", n =>
      connected.has(n.id) ? (n.type==="species"?1:0.95) : 0.25)
    link.attr("stroke-opacity", l =>
      connected.has(l.source.id) && connected.has(l.target.id) ? 0.75 : 0.05)
  })

  node.on("mouseleave", function() {
    node.selectAll("circle").attr("fill-opacity", n => n.type==="species"?1:0.85)
    link.attr("stroke-opacity", 0.4)
  })

  // click → populate panel
  node.on("click", function(event, d) {
    event.stopPropagation()

    const relatedEdges = links.filter(l =>
      l.source.id === d.id || l.target.id === d.id
    )

    let html = ""

    if (d.type === "species") {
      html = `<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:${d.colour};margin-bottom:8px">
        <em>${d.label}</em> — research themes</div>`
      relatedEdges.forEach(l => {
        html += `<span style="display:inline-block;background:${l.target.colour};color:#fff;
          border-radius:4px;padding:2px 10px;margin:2px;font-size:12px">
          ${l.target.label} (${l.weight})</span>`
      })
    } else {
      const papersBySpecies = {}
      relatedEdges.forEach(l => {
        const sp = l.source.id === "bd" ? "B. dorsalis" : "C. capitata"
        const col = l.source.id === "bd" ? "#2E7D9E" : "#C05C28"
        if (!papersBySpecies[sp]) papersBySpecies[sp] = { papers: l.papers, colour: col }
      })

      html = `<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:${d.colour};margin-bottom:10px">
        ${d.label}</div>`

      Object.entries(papersBySpecies).forEach(([sp, {papers, colour}]) => {
        html += `<div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12px;color:${colour};
          margin-bottom:5px;margin-top:8px"><em>${sp}</em></div>`
        html += `<ol style="margin:0;padding-left:18px">`
        papers.forEach(p => {
          html += `<li style="margin-bottom:4px">`
          if (p.url) {
            html += `<a href="${p.url}" target="_blank"
              style="color:#2E7D9E;text-decoration:none;font-size:12px">${p.title}</a>`
          } else {
            html += `<span style="font-size:12px;color:#555">${p.title}</span>`
          }
          html += `</li>`
        })
        html += `</ol>`
      })
    }

    panel.style.display = "block"
    panel.innerHTML = html
  })

  // reset
  svg.on("click", function() {
    node.selectAll("circle").attr("fill-opacity", n => n.type==="species"?1:0.85)
    link.attr("stroke-opacity", 0.4)
    panel.style.display = "none"
  })

  sim.on("tick", () => {
    link
      .attr("x1", d => d.source.x).attr("y1", d => d.source.y)
      .attr("x2", d => d.target.x).attr("y2", d => d.target.y)
    node.attr("transform", d =>
      `translate(${Math.max(45,Math.min(W-45,d.x))},${Math.max(45,Math.min(H-45,d.y))})`
    )
  })

  // legend
  const lg = svg.append("g").attr("transform","translate(16,16)")
  const ld = [
    { colour: "#2E7D9E", label: "B. dorsalis only" },
    { colour: "#C05C28", label: "C. capitata only" },
    { colour: "#7B5EA7", label: "Both species" }
  ]
  ld.forEach((l,i) => {
    lg.append("circle").attr("cx",8).attr("cy",i*22).attr("r",7)
      .attr("fill",l.colour).attr("fill-opacity",0.9)
    lg.append("text").attr("x",20).attr("y",i*22+4)
      .attr("font-size","11px").attr("fill","#444").text(l.label)
  })
  lg.append("text").attr("x",0).attr("y",78)
    .attr("font-size","10px").attr("fill","#999")
    .text("Edge width = paper count")

  yield svg.node()
  yield panel
}
